motions.label: Learned driving · speed and turning
motions.description: The learned actor follows speed and turn commands, then stops and balances. This mixed example passes both physics timesteps. 10/12 fresh starting sequences pass at both timesteps.
motions.limit_text: 20/24 rollouts pass all tracking, posture and stopping gates. The actor alone commands all four motors at 100 Hz using IMU, encoders and explicit commands. Supervised learning from a privileged reference; no teacher control or pose correction in this replay. Same 120 mm design, nominal flat floor and rigid tires. Terrain, hardware uncertainty, internal self-contact and printed strength remain unqualified.
